page.overview:
What is Fazbear Friendly Face?

, shorted to simply the Friendly Face, is the titular hybrid animatronic in Friendly Face, the first story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Fazbear Friendly Faces are animatronic recreations of deceased pets in which the pet’s face is integrated onto an animatronic body. An example of a Friendly Face used in an advertisement is a robotic orange cat.

Edward’s Friendly Face is meant to be a robotic black cat, but after submitting the wrong black hair the cat body instead has Jack’s stiff, dead powder-white face. It has Jack’s brown eyes, slightly flat nose, thick lips turned up in an unyielding smile, and broad chin. Edward buries his Friendly Face but it escapes, covering itself in mud.

Fazbear Friendly Faces are meant to be recreations of deceased pets manufactured by Fazbear Entertainment. They are created by first extracting DNA from the pet's hairs submitted by its owner, which is then used to create an accurate recreation of the pet's face. The face is added onto a realistic animatronic body and turned into a loyal pet that will follow its owner around forever.
